format: antimatter15 .splat, 32 bytes a splat, gzip; model metres and axes (x east, y up, z south)
method: trained, not synthesised: OpenSplat on the CPU from 480 synthetic drone frames of the model (cw-photo-480/first-n3000-d2.splat); cropped to the flown area plus 150 m and -30 to 260 m OD, splats over 25 m dropped (21222 of 188295 removed)
groups_note: uint16 a splat in file order: index into groups, 65535 = ground; groups: [centre x, centre z, base m OD, top m OD, model building index]; a splat is in a building when it lies inside the footprint (2 m grace) between base - 2 m and top + 6 m; 85153 of 167073 grouped
